review.optional-request-body-approximated: Four card-account POST request bodies omit `required`, whose OpenAPI 3.0 default is false. The overlay makes that explicit; rc.112 represents the optional body as an HttpApiSchema.NoContent alternative and emits this warning. Effect v4 rc.112 OpenApi.fromApi currently writes required:true for any non-empty body, so downstream OpenAPI round-tripping cannot preserve this source optionality, although the generated endpoint retains the no-content payload alternative.
review.response-headers-ignored: The only two instances are the Content-Disposition attachment headers on the PDF statement endpoints. The generated HttpApi schema retains the application/pdf Uint8Array body, but rc.112 cannot describe response headers; consumers that need the filename can select decoded-and-response mode and inspect the raw HttpClientResponse.
